summary: Iteration 5 verification: (1) channel order in output preserved from input, (2) edit sub-rows sorted highest-first (45→30→20→10), (3) Spotcraft/Ubaid Hakim branding in header + logo 'S'. All 3 pytest cases pass; frontend E2E flow (upload → edits → dates → generate → results + download) succeeded end-to-end.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' logged in console — chart container renders before layout settles; non-blocking cosmetic issue

action_items: OPTIONAL/PREVIEW-ONLY: In the preview environment the emergent-main.js script overrides the browser tab title to 'Emergent | Fullstack App'. The index.html source is correct ('Spotcraft — by Ubaid Hakim'). This will only apply in production/deployed builds. No code change required unless product wants a runtime document.title override in App.js.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_output_workbook correctly derives market_ord/genre_ord/channel_ord from raw_rows iteration order and uses them as stable sort keys — good approach for preserving input ordering.
Edit sort key uses -int(edit_duration) — correct for descending order. Verified with out-of-order input edits=[10,45,30,20]: all output blocks emit 45,30,20,10.
server.py is 1156 lines — recommend splitting build_output_workbook and related helpers into a separate module for maintainability (out of scope for this iteration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration5.py verifies: channel-order-matches-input, edit-durations-descending (uses monotonic chunking to handle repeated (channel,program,row_no) blocks), and regression check for Grand Total + 3 Weekly sections. Uses BASE_URL env with a fallback. Backend endpoints are POST /api/plans/upload, POST /api/plans/{id}/generate, GET /api/results/{id}/download.
rca of the issue: N/A — all fixes validated. Root cause of prior iteration bugs were: (a) output used alphabetic sort on channel because sort key didn't reference input row position — fixed by building *_ord dicts from raw_rows enumeration; (b) edits sorted ascending because +int used as key — fixed by using -int for descending.
